scripts.install:all: cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install && cd ../agent && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev" "cd agent && bun run dev"
scripts.build: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run build" "cd frontend && bun run build" "cd agent && bun run build"
scripts.test: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run test" "cd frontend && bun run test" "cd agent && bun run test"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run typecheck" "cd frontend && bun run typecheck" "cd agent && bun run typecheck"
scripts.prettier: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run prettier" "cd frontend && bun run prettier" "cd agent && bun run prettier"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run lint" "cd frontend && bun run lint" "cd agent && bun run lint"
scripts.fix: concurrently -n backend,frontend,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && bun run fix" "cd frontend && bun run fix" "cd agent && bun run fix"
